feed.title: Venning Family Games
feed.subtitle: New games and updates on the family games hub.

entry.title: Cookie Crumble
entry.summary: Run a cookie shop. Mix the dough, cut the shape somebody asked for, and be standing at the oven when the gauge hits the green stripe — a second late is crispy and five is burnt. Then ice it, add sprinkles if they wanted them, and get it to the counter before anybody gives up waiting. Your hands only hold one tray, which is the whole problem. Twenty shifts across five weeks, each ending on a Big Day, and an endless Big Rush for the leaderboard. The game was invented by Dulcie, who wrote down all eight steps.

entry.title: Bubble & Brew
entry.summary: A push-your-luck game at an alchemist's cauldron. Draw ingredients out of your bag one at a time — each one stirs the potion higher and the points climb faster near the top, but too much fizzroot and the lid comes off and the round is gone. Stop in time, spend the coins at the apothecary, and the bag you gamble with next round is the one you just built. Twenty recipes, a bottomless cauldron for the leaderboard, and a Daily everyone plays with the identical bag.

entry.title: Wonder Museum
entry.summary: A word search with a museum wrapped round it. Fourteen wings and a hundred and twelve rooms, and every room you finish puts a real exhibit in your album with a fact on the back of it. There is a Daily Puzzle the whole family plays on the same grid.

entry.title: Number Ninja
entry.summary: Numbers fly up from the dojo floor: slice the right ones and let the rest fall. Twelve belts take the 2 to 12 times tables one at a time and then all at once, and the wrong answers are the ones people actually give, so nothing can be guessed by eye.

entry.title: Canary Deep
entry.summary: Minesweeper, a thousand feet down a coal mine, and no board here ever needs a guess. A solver plays every board through first, and any that would come down to a coin toss is thrown away. Eighteen shifts down three seams, plus a Daily Seam on the same board for everyone.

entry.title: Scribble Speedway
entry.summary: Draw a racetrack with your finger and the game turns your scribble into a real circuit, then puts seven rivals on it. Eighteen challenges across four chapters, and a Daily Circuit where the whole family gets the same field and each draws their own way round it.

entry.title: Rocket Rescue
entry.summary: Little creatures are stranded down in the caves and you have the only ship small enough to reach them. Twenty caves across four worlds, each ending somewhere a Guardian lives, plus Deep Rescue: one endless cave a day, the same one for everybody.

entry.title: Turret Town
entry.summary: They are coming up the road. Build something. Archer Posts, Bomb Lobbers, Frost Fans, Tesla Coils and Watchtowers against armour, flyers and splitters. 15 maps, three bosses, an armoury, and an endless Long Siege for the rest of us to chase.

entry.title: Ricochet Spire
entry.summary: Slay the Spire meets Breakout. Bounce a ball, break some bricks, then start drafting cards and watch it turn into something else. A branching map of battles, elites, shops, campfires and bosses, and a Daily Challenge on one seed a day. Aimed at teens and grown-ups.

entry.title: Sorting Office
entry.summary: Every parcel has a box: find it. Sort by shape, then colour, then two things at once, then by counting stamps, then by reading the label. Then the bell rings, the rule changes and every box swaps its label. No timer and nothing to lose.

entry.title: Critter Clash
entry.summary: Take your turn, there is no clock. Lead three critters against the bugs across 20 levels and three bosses, and use the garden against them: bugs cannot swim, so one good shove into the pond beats three hits. Two of you can play on one iPad.

entry.title: Word Siege
entry.summary: Hangman with a castle instead of a gallows. Every miss is a boulder through your wall, and the wall has to last the whole siege, not just one word. 18 sieges, six realms, 144 words with clues, and an armoury to spend your coins in.

entry.title: Beat Bugs
entry.summary: Tap the bugs in time with the music and watch them dance. Twelve cheerful songs from gentle two-lane tunes to fast four-lane raves. No timers and no losing, just stars to earn and more songs to unlock.

entry.title: Reel Rush
entry.summary: You have hooked a fish deep in the ocean, now reel it up to the boat. Hold to reel, slide to steer past sharks and sea mines, and stay ahead of the deep shark rising below. Land it and the next cast goes deeper for a bigger catch.

entry.title: Alien Chomp
entry.summary: You are a starving alien loose in the city. Eat every human you can to keep your hunger up, but never bite a robot. Jump, dive-slam and chomp your way from the suburbs to the spaceport.

entry.title: Deep Jungle
entry.summary: Run, jump and swim through 6 jungle worlds hunting a lost city of gold. Find secret passages, unlock explorer gear and beat the boss of every world.

entry.title: Brick Breaker DX
entry.summary: Smash neon bricks, catch power-ups and battle bosses across a 30-level campaign. Earn coins, buy upgrades and chase the family high score.

entry.title: Bible Quest
entry.summary: Journey through 17 Bible stories, from Creation to the Early Church. Answer multiple-choice questions, earn stars and unlock the next story.

entry.title: Monza
entry.summary: The classic racing dice board game, rebuilt for the web. Roll the coloured dice and steer your car around the track to the chequered flag. Two to six players.

entry.title: Chicken Cross
entry.summary: Hop your chicken across busy roads, rushing rivers and railway lines. How far can you get before the traffic gets you?

entry.title: WordVoyage
entry.summary: A word puzzle adventure around the globe. Solve puzzles, collect stars and voyage from country to country.

entry.title: Block Party
entry.summary: Drag the blocks, fill a line, make it sparkle. A gentle block puzzle made for little hands: no timer, no losing, lots of confetti.
